prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right attorney depends on your case (severity of injuries, disputed liability, insurance issues), your budget, and how you want the case handled (settlement vs trial). I can help you find a strong attorney, but first here’s how to pick one and where to look.

What to look for
- Relevant experience: substantial car-accident and bodily-injury caseload, not just occasional auto claims.
- Trial experience: many cases settle, but you want a lawyer who will and can take your case to trial if needed.
- Track record: past settlements/verdicts for similar injuries (not guaranteed results, but informative).
- Client reviews and references: consistent positive feedback on communication and results.
- Fee structure: most work on contingency (typical 33–40% of recovery); confirm expenses and when fees are charged.
- Accessibility and communication: clear point of contact and regular updates.
- Resources: firm can hire accident reconstructionists, medical experts, etc., if your case needs them.
- Board/peer recognition: Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell ratings, local awards, and Texas State Bar standing.

Where to search and verify
- Texas State Bar — confirm license and any disciplinary history.
- Houston Bar Association lawyer referral service.
- Directories and rating services: Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Google and Facebook reviews.
- Ask for referrals from friends, doctors, or other attorneys (if you know any).

Questions to ask during a free consult
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Have you handled cases with injuries like mine?
- Who in the firm will handle my case day-to-day?
- What is your fee and how are expenses handled?
- What is a reasonable range of outcomes for my case, and how long will it take?
- Can you provide references or examples of results?

If you want, I can:
- Suggest several well-rated Houston personal injury firms (I’ll need your ZIP or neighborhood).
- Draft a short list of questions to use in consultations.
- Help evaluate two or three lawyers’ websites or reviews if you paste them here.

Which would you prefer? If you want attorney names, tell me your Houston ZIP code or neighborhood and a bit about your case (injury severity, who’s at fault, whether police/insurance already involved).
